facts.value: South Asia has a peninsula-like shape bordered by three bodies of water: the Indian Ocean to the south, the Bay of Bengal to the east, and the Arabian Sea to the west.
Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, India, Afghanistan, Pakistan, Bhutan, Nepal, Iran, and the Maldives.
most densely populated area in the world
South Asia stretches from the snow-clad Himalaya, Karakoram, and Hindu Kush ranges across the fertile Indo-Gangetic plain to tropical peninsulas and island archipelagos in the Indian Ocean.
arid Thar Desert, lush monsoon-fed Western Ghats, and deltaic lowlands like the Sundarbans
